column1: # The SYMMETRY lane's instances (M15-symmetry-T2, D-0179). scripts/sym_lane.sh reads this file.
# name             source                                   depth expect controls tier
#                         ENC=2 (parities as sums, sum x = 2y) by MiniZinc for tools/baguette.msc
#           mzn:@CODES/D  the same with D under $CODES_CP (default /cluster/arthur/codes-cp)
#   controls  yes: the four mutation controls run on this model (satisfiable ones only: a `red` or
#             `dom` line over a database that is already unsatisfiable proves nothing, D-0053)
#   tier      small runs by default, big only with --big
# The codes are codes-cp's minimum-distance models without fixed coordinates (dom/sym_p*_nofix.dzn;
# the two Hamming files are dom/sym_p7_w2.dzn with nF = 0): is there a nonzero codeword of weight at
# most Wmax? Extended Hamming [8,4,4], Golay [24,12,8], QR32 [32,16,8], QR48 [48,24,12].
